description: Cogitate (2025): an exploratory dynamic functional connectivity analysis found content-selective synchrony between frontal and early visual areas, and in iEEG significant content-selective synchrony for both categories in the prefrontal region.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered. Exploratory, not preregistered.

sources.quote: content-specific synchronization between frontal and early visual areas
